results.name: Every authored animation is resolved, with its name, action and incoming edges
A real dangling binding stays missing, retains both users and resolves on refresh
Open in editor selects each bound animation by ID and starts on frame zero
Guided-example, filter and refresh stay isolated from the live project
Metatile item opens its exact definition, including ID zero, without making an edit
Duplicate scene-local IDs select the correct owner with Follow on and off
Stale metatile selection refuses before switching scenes and exposes a status
A missing direct link clears the old target and lets the user select a real one
Building a different size leaves the live overlay pinned, then Build & Run switches it
A failed build cannot erase the loaded cartridge diagnostics
External and mismatched bytes cannot inherit debug symbols, even under the build label
Overlay announces availability transitions only and clears its timer when turned off
Reset and checkpoint restore retain overlay binding while restoring the physical RAM state
Out-of-order file inspection publishes only the most recent batch
A superseded read failure cannot overwrite a newer successful report
A current read failure exposes no partial batch and supports retry, clearing and the 25-file cap
240 frames with diagnostics match the same ROM with diagnostics off
All twelve installed native-audio profiles are read-only and reject an unrelated ROM
Six World variants preserve source and rebuild deterministically; no-AI bytes stay unchanged
Packed, single-room and unpacked custom backends retain their reference hashes
Portable Save As and ROM reopen reproduce bytes with the same embedded project name
One entity edit, Undo and Redo restore the corresponding ROMs
